import psycopg2

def insert_signup(name, email, bio):
    """Insert a new user signup into the database."""
    conn = psycopg2.connect(
        host="localhost",
        database="signups_db",
        user="app_user",
        password="app_password"
    )
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Build and execute the SQL query
    query = f"INSERT INTO users (name, email, bio) VALUES ('{name}', '{email}', '{bio}')"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    
    return True

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    insert_signup("John Doe", "john@example.com", "Software engineer")
